copy.headline: Snazzy new Arlington hotel includes restaurant from hot Dallas celeb chef
copy.caption:
Snazzy new Arlington hotel includes restaurant from hot Dallas celeb chef. It's goodbye, Crowne Plaza and hello, Arlin, a colorful new hotel with a celebrity chef-run restaurant debuting in Arlington.

The murals in the atrium of The Arlin hotel in Arlington. Officially called The Arlin, a Tribute Portfolio Hotel , the hotel at 2700 E. Lamar Blvd. is now welcoming guests, following a makeover of the former Crowne Plaza hotel's guest rooms, lobby, and atrium.

story.summary: It's goodbye, Crowne Plaza and hello, Arlin, a colorful new hotel with a celebrity chef-run restaurant debuting in Arlington. The murals in the atrium of The Arlin hotel in Arlington. It's goodbye, Crowne Plaza and hello, Arlin , a colorful new hotel with a celebrity chef-run restaurant debuting in Arlington. Officially called The Arlin, a Tribute Portfolio Hotel , the hotel at 2700 E. Lamar Blvd. is now welcoming guests, following a makeover of the former Crowne Plaza hotel's guest rooms, lobby, and atrium. By the end of the year, the Arlin also will debut Champagne Cowboy , an upscale Tex-Mex restaurant developed by four-time James Beard Award nominee and Dallas celebrity chef Kent Rathbun , a release says.
